annotations.title: List delivery attempts for a message

description: List every delivery attempt Svix made for one message, across endpoints — status, response code and body. This is the tool for answering 'why did this webhook not arrive?'. Svix REST: GET /api/v1/app/{app_id}/attempt/msg/{msg_id}.

app_id.description: The application's Svix id or uid.

iterator.description: Cursor from the previous page's `iterator` field. Omit for the first page.

status.description: Filter by attempt status: 0 success, 1 pending, 2 fail, 3 sending.

name: svix_list_attempts_by_message
title: List delivery attempts for a message
